Actually CAP theorem states that a distributed data store cannot simultaneously provide all three of Consistency, Availability, Partition tolerance. Provide formal definitions: C: all reads receive most recent write or error; A: every request receives a response; P: system continues to operate despite network partitions.

We should also discuss CP: systems that choose consistency over availability when partition occurs (e.g., MongoDB with majority read concern, HBase, Zookeeper, etc.

We should also mention that many modern systems allow tuning between CP and AP.
